verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a versioned REST API (v1), and a runtime probe confirms the live endpoint at rest.runpod.io/v1 with an OpenAPI spec. The docs also point to an agent-driven migration path to REST, which implies an older API surface is being superseded. However, no deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version-support guarantees are documented. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines for the GraphQL API, a version lifecycle or support-window commitments, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
To migrate automatically, ask your coding agent to run `/runpod:migrate rest` once you've installed the Runpod skills plugin.
https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
